items: Meet at Airport in Rome and drive to Cassino.
Study the strategic background to the Italian Campaign, orientate to the ground and set the scene for the four battles January-May 44.
Study and view of the crossing sites on the River Rapido by 36 (Texas) Infantry Division in the first battle 20-23 January 1944.

Study and view the ground over which 34 (Red Bulls) Infantry Division advanced in 24 January-12 February 1944 in the first battle across the River Rapido and their break-in onto the ridges behind the Monastery. Visit Hove Dump.
Study the ground on Monastery Hill and appreciate why this position dominated the battlefield. Examine the controversial decision to bomb the Benedictine Monastery on 15 February 1944.

Study and view the ground over which part of 5 New Zealand Infantry Brigade attacked up the railway causeway on 17-18 February 1944 in an attempt to get armour into the Liri valley during the second battle and the concurrent attack by 5 Indian Brigade up on Snakeshead Ridge towards Point 593.
Study and view the terrain over which II (NZ) Corps attacked up Monastery Hill and into Cassino town during the third battle on 15-23 March 1944.

Study the Amazon Bridge, the crossing point on the River Rapido for 4 British Infantry Division on 12-13 May 1944, and appreciate the enormity of the challenge that the soldiers from the Corps of Royal Engineers faced at this site.
The 3rd Carpathian Infantry Division monument on Point 593 at Cassino
Walk and study the route of the Cavendish Road tank attack behind the Monastery on 19 March 1944.
Study the enormous logistical problems of resupplying troops on the ridges from Caira and the Allied efforts to meet this challenge.

Study the ground on Snakeshead Ridge, Point 593 and Point 575 over which the 34 (Red Bulls) Infantry Division fought in the first battle, 4 Indian Infantry Division in the second battle and II (PO) Corps in the fourth battle.
Examine the role of the Poles in the battle and the circumstances that led them to Monte Cassino.
Study the fourth and final battle and appreciate the efforts and gallantry of the Eighth Army in finally breaking the Gustav Line in May 1944.
Study the 1 (Canadian) Corps assault on the Hitler Line on 23 May 1944 – the day of the Anzio breakout.
Study the 36 (Texas) Infantry Division plan to slip between the inter-Corps boundary for LXXVI Panzer Corps and I Parachute Corps and break the Fourteenth Army’s defence on 29-30 May 1944.
Return to Airport in Rome.

images.cap: View of the Monastery from the Polish Cemetery

items: Meet at Airport in Rome and drive to Cassino.
Study the strategic background to the Italian Campaign and set the scene for the battles to break the Gustav Line and reach Rome from Jan-May 44.
Study the X (BR) Corps plan to cross the Garigliano and get into the Ausente valley.

Study the 10th Battalion Royal Berkshire Regiment attack on 11 January 1944 to secure the near bank of the Garigliano in preparation for the 56 British Infantry Division’s assault river crossing on 17 January 1944.
Study the 56 British Infantry Division’s struggle to capture and hold Monte Damiano and San Salvatito in January to March 1944.
Study the 5 British Infantry Division’s battle to capture and hold the Minturno-Tufo Ridge on 17-22 January 1944.
Visit to Minturno CWGC Cemetery.
Visit to the American Sicily to Rome War Cemetery.
Study the challenges of the landings at Anzio on 22 January 1944 and the controversies of the first two months of the operation.
Study the logistical challenges of operating Anzio port January-June 1944 and the VI (US) Corps AA defences that were established to protect the flow of stores into the beachhead.
Study 24 Guards Brigade’s initial breakout towards Carroceto and the Factory on 28 January 1944.
Study the 1st Battalion Irish Guards and 1st Battalion Scot Guards night attack on 29-30 January 1944 to establish a Line of Departure for 3 Infantry Brigade to reach Campoleone.

Study the attack by 3 British Infantry Brigade on 30-31 January 1944 to seize the major road and railway junction at Campoleone as a prelude to a 1 British Infantry Division operation to reach Albano and Genzano.
Study the catastrophic Rangers’ infiltration up the Pantano Ditch on 30 January 1944 as the spearhead of 3 (Rock of the Marne) Infantry Division’s assault on Cisterna
Study the collapse of 6th Battalion Gordon Highlanders’ position on 4 February 1944 and its impact on the security of the Campoleone Salient.
Study the defensive position of 10th Battalion Royal Berkshire Regiment on the right of the base of the Campoleone Salient over 2-11 February 1944.

Study the defensive positions of 2nd Battalion North Staffordshire Regiment and 5th Battalion Grenadier Guards on Buonriposo Ridge on the left of the base of the Campoleone Salient over 5-10 February 1944 including Major Philip Sidney’s Victoria Cross action.

Study the desperate establishment of 1 British Infantry Division’s and 45 (Thunderbird) Infantry Division’s Final Defence Line and the defence activities in the British Sector 15 February-1 March 1944.
Study the defensive positions of 10th Battalion Royal Berkshire Regiment, 1st Battalion London Irish Rifles and 1st Battalion Irish Guards in the ‘wadis’ during February 1944.
Study the defensive positions in wadis on the left of the defensive line in front of Buonriposo Ridge as an example of the conditions endured by British and US troops Feb-May 44.
Study the four options drawn up by HQ VI (US) Corps for the breakout from Anzio and the breakout itself on 23 May 1944.
Study the outcome of Op BUFFALO and the initial success of the US breakout towards Valmontone 23-25 May 44.
Study the progress of Op BUFFALO after General Mark Clark’s controversial decision to switch to Op TURTLE on 25 May 1944.
Study the brilliant 36 (Texas) Infantry Division plan to slip between the inter-Corps boundary for LXXVI Panzer Corps and I Parachute Corps and break the Fourteenth Army’s defence on 29-30 May 1944.
Return to Airport in Rome.

images.cap: Private James Ashby. 10th Battalion Berkshire Regiment. Killed in Action on 25 February 1944. Buried in the Beachhead CWGC Cemetery at Anzio. Kimmo Veikkolainen

items: Meet at Ancona Airport and drive to Montefabbri.
Study the strategic background to the Italian Campaign, orientate to the ground and set the scene for the battle for the Gothic Line in September 1944.
Study the background to the decision to launch Op OLIVE – the Eighth Army’s attack on the Gothic Line along the Adriatic coast.
Study the advance by 5 Indian Infantry Brigade over the River Foglia and up onto Monte della Croce on 30 August 1944 as it pushed north towards Tavoleto.
Study the advance by 5 Indian Infantry Brigade towards Monte Calvo on 31 August 1944 as it pushed north towards Tavoleto.

Study the plan and execution of the deliberate 5 Indian Infantry Brigade attack on Tavoleto, assess its failure on 1-3 September 1944 and then examine 11 Indian Infantry Brigade’s plan and execution on the night of 3-4 September 1944.
Study the 11 Indian Infantry Brigade plan to secure San Pietro Ridge on 4-5 September 1944.
Study the execution of the 11 Indian Infantry Brigade plan to secure San Pietro Ridge on 4-7 September 1944.
Study the 1 British Armoured Division’s advance into the Conca valley intended to exploit 46 British Infantry Division’s success.
Members of the Monte Cassino Society in San Marino whilst studying the Gothic Line on 6 October 2025.
Study the 1 British Armoured Division’s disastrous attack towards the River Marano on 4-5 September 1944.
Study 56 British Infantry Division’s attacks on Croce on 4-9 September 1944.
Study the 169 British Infantry Brigade attack on Gemmano Ridge on 8-10 September 1944.
Study the 138 British Infantry Brigade attack on Gemmano Ridge on 10-13 September 1944.
Study the 11 Indian Infantry Brigade plan and execution to secure Point 449 on the western end of Gemmano Ridge on 15 September 1944.

Study the 5 Indian Infantry Brigade plan for the advance on San Marino on 17-18 September 1944, examine why it stalled and examine how 11 Indian Infantry Brigade regained the momentum on 19 September 1944.
Study the 11 Indian Infantry Brigade action to clear San Marino on 20 September 1944 and push west towards the River Marecchia.
Visit the Coriano Ridge CWGC Cemetery.
Study the 5 Canadian Armoured Division’s attack on Coriano Ridge as part of Op OLIVE – the Allied plan to breach the Gothic Line.
Visit the grave of Rifleman Sher Bahadur Thapa VC in the Rimini Gurkha CWGC Cemetery.
Frank de Planta explaining the 4 & 5 September 1944 2 Armoured Brigade advance towards the San Savino-Passano Ridge.
Study 4 British Infantry Division’s subsequent role as the follow-on force over the River Marano and into Ospedaletto.
Study 4 British Infantry Division’s operation to seize the northern end of Ripabianca Ridge.
Study the 10 British Infantry Brigade operation to clear Cerasolo in order to allow the 4 British Infantry Division’s advance to continue.
Study the 10 British Infantry Brigade operation to clear the lower slopes of San Acquilina Ridge prior to the 4 British Infantry Division’s assault to clear the southern end of San Fortunato Ridge.
Study the 10 British Infantry Brigade attack to clear the rest of San Acquilina Ridge prior to the 4 British Infantry Division’s assault to clear the southern end of San Fortunato Ridge.
Study the 1/6th Battalion East Surrey Regiment attack to clear the southern end of San Fortunato Ridge for which Major WBE Brown was awarded a Military Cross for gallantry.
Study 4 British Infantry Division’s part in the final stage of Op OLIVE – the crossing of the River Marecchia.
Visit the Gradara CWGC Cemetery.
View of Tavoleto from Gemmano.
Return to Ancona Airport.

images.cap: Gothic Line group at the Rifleman Sher Bahadur Thapa VC memorial in San Marino in April 2018

items: Meet at Ciampino or Fiumicino Airport and spend the rest of the day visiting Rome.
Study the brisk advance of Fifth Army between 5-30 June 1944 as the Germans fell back to the Dora Line.
Visit to Bolsena CWGC Cemetery. The site of the first camp occupied by 15 Army Group Advanced HQ after the fall of Rome and where King George VI visited Alexander in July 1944.
Visit to Orvieto CWGC Cemetery. Study the Eighth Army advance north after the fall of Rome.
Study the USAAF attack on Allerona Bridge on 28 January 1944 that destroyed a train carrying Allied Prisoners of War to Germany.
Study the 10 British Infantry Brigade attack on the Casamaggiore-Frattavecchia Ridge as part of the Allied plan to break the Trasimene Line.
Visit to Foiana di Chiana CWGC Cemetery.
Study the 10 British Infantry Brigade attacks into the hills around Civitella di Chiana as part of the Allied plan to break the Arezzo Line.
Study the 1/6th Battalion East Surrey Regiment attack to clear the ground north of Ricasoli in the 4 British Infantry Division’s advance north to Florence.
Study the 10 British Infantry Brigade attack on the Incontro Monastery to clear the Germans from the heights overlooking Florence and the River Arno.
Visit to Florence American Cemetery.
Visit to German Cemetery in the Futa Pass.
Study the defensive actions by 2nd Battalion Royal Scots on Monte Castellaro on 25-28 November 1944 on the most northerly position in the Fifth Army line.
Study the defensive actions by 19 Indian Infantry Brigade on Monte Grande-Monte Cerere on 11-12 December 1944 as part of Fifth Army.
Visit to Gradara CWGC Cemetery.
Visit to Montecchio CWGC Cemetery.
Study the background to the decision to launch Op OLIVE – the Eighth Army’s attack on the Gothic Line along the Adriatic coast.
Study the advance by 5 Indian Infantry Brigade over the River Foglia and up onto Monte della Croce on 30 August 1944 as it pushed north towards Tavoleto.
Study the advance by 5 Indian Infantry Brigade towards Monte Calvo on 31 August 1944 as it pushed north towards Tavoleto.

Study the plan and execution of the deliberate 5 Indian Infantry Brigade attack on Tavoleto, assess its failure on 1-3 September 1944 and then examine 11 Indian Infantry Brigade’s plan and execution on the night of 3-4 September 1944.
Study the 11 Indian Infantry Brigade plan to secure San Pietro Ridge on 4-5 September 1944.
Study the execution of the 11 Indian Infantry Brigade plan to secure San Pietro Ridge on 4-7 September 1944.
Study the 1 British Armoured Division’s advance into the Conca valley intended to exploit 46 British Infantry Division’s success.
Study the 1 British Armoured Division’s forlorn attack towards the River Marano on 4-5 September 1944.
Study 56 British Infantry Division’s attacks on Croce on 4-9 September 1944.
Study the 169 British Infantry Brigade attack on Gemmano Ridge on 8-10 September 1944.
Study the 138 British Infantry Brigade attack on Gemmano Ridge on 10-13 September 1944.
Study the 11 Indian Infantry Brigade plan and execution to secure Point 449 on the western end of Gemmano Ridge on 15 September 1944.

Study the 5 Indian Infantry Brigade plan for the advance on San Marino on 17-18 September 1944, examine why it stalled and examine how 11 Indian Infantry Brigade regained the momentum on 19 September 1944.
Study the 11 Indian Infantry Brigade action to clear San Marino on 20 September 1944 and push west towards the River Marecchia.
Visit to Coriano Ridge CWGC Cemetery.
Study the 5 Canadian Armoured Division’s attack on Coriano Ridge as part of Op OLIVE – the Allied plan to breach the Gothic Line.
Study 4 British Infantry Division’s subsequent role as the follow-on force over the River Marano and into Ospedaletto.
Study 4 British Infantry Division’s operation to seize the northern end of Ripabianca Ridge.
Study the 10 British Infantry Brigade operation to clear Cerasolo in order to allow the 4 British Infantry Division’s advance to continue.
Study the 10 British Infantry Brigade operation to clear the lower slopes of San Acquilina Ridge prior to the 4 British Infantry Division’s assault to clear the southern end of San Fortunato Ridge.
Study the 10 British Infantry Brigade attack to clear the rest of San Acquilina Ridge prior to the 4 British Infantry Division’s assault to clear the southern end of San Fortunato Ridge.
Study the 1/6th Battalion East Surrey Regiment attack to clear the southern end of San Fortunato Ridge for which Major WBE Brown was awarded a Military Cross for gallantry.
Visit the Queen’s Bays Memorial.
Study 4 British Infantry Division’s part in the final stage of Op OLIVE – the crossing of the River Marecchia.
Study the 15 Army Group plan in April 1944 to encircle the majority of the German Army in Italy using Fifth and Eighth Armies – Op GRAPESHOT.
Study the 2 Commando Brigade assault on the Lake Comacchio spit in an attempt to draw German attention to this area as part of Op GRAPESHOT.
Study the 24 Guards Brigade assault on the Fosse Marina bridges in an attempt to facilitate the 78 British Infantry Division’s break into the Argenta Gap.
Study the attack by V (BR) Corps and 8 Indian Infantry Division to cross the Senio and Santerno on 9 April 1945 as part of Op GRAPESHOT.
Study the attack by V (BR) Corps and 2 New Zealand Division to cross the Senio and Santerno on 9 April 1945 as part of Op GRAPESHOT.
Study the attack by V (BR) Corps and 78 British Infantry Division northwards through the Argenta Gap on 12 April 1945 as part of Op GRAPESHOT.
Visit to Bologna Polish War Cemetery.
Visit to Museo Memoriale della Liberta.
Move to Bologna Airport.
Meet at Airport in Naples and drive to Salerno.
Study the strategic background to the Italian Campaign, orientate to the ground and set the scene for the battle for Salerno in September 1943.
Study the 2 Commando Brigade battle to secure and then hold the La Molina defile from 9-13 September 1943.
Study the 36 (Texas) Infantry Division landing and their advance into the foothills from 9-11 September 1943.
Study the consequences of the VI (US) Corps plan to expand the beachhead and close the inter-Corps boundary using its reserve from 45 (Thunderbird) Infantry Division from 11-12 September 1943.
Study 142 Infantry Regiment’s attack on, and defence of, Altavilla and Point 424 on 11-12 September 1943 and 143 Infantry Regiment’s failed attack on 13 September 1943.
Study 45 (Thunderbird) Infantry Division’s dramatic defence of the beachhead at Borgo San Cesareo when the Germans attempted to breakthrough down the Sele-Calore Corridor on 13 September 1943.
Study the 56 British Infantry Division landings north of the River Sele on 9-10 September 1943 and their battles for Montecorvino Airfield and Battipaglia.
Study 201 Guards Brigade’s actions in and around the ‘Tobacco Factory’ on 10-13 September 1943.
Study the 2 (Army) Commando and 41 RM Commando raid on Piegolello and its subsequent defence from 15-17 September 1943.
Study the 46 British Infantry Division’s landings in and around Salerno town on 9-10 September 1943 and their battles to secure the exit routes through the Sorrento Peninsula to Naples.
Study the X (BR) Corps and VI (US) Corps breakout from the Salerno Plain towards Naples and Avellino from 16 September-1 October 1943.
Return to Airport in Naples.
